main_turf.bias_notes: Anti-clockwise (left-handed). Reconstructed and widened to 23 metres, Seymour is a highly regarded, spacious, and fair Victorian track. The 380m home straight gives swoopers every opportunity, while broad sweeping turns allow momentum building.
main_turf.post_bias: Extremely fair due to long runs into the first turn, especially from the 1100m, 1200m, and 1300m sprint chutes which provide a long straight run before the bend. Wide barriers are far less of a penalty here than at tighter country tracks.

handicapping_angles.fair_track_swooper_boost: Because the track is expansive and 23m wide, one-dimensional front-runners often tire down the 380m straight. Upgrade 'Swoopers' (closers) with strong late sectionals.
handicapping_angles.chute_start_allowance: In 1100m, 1200m, and 1300m sprints, do not heavily penalize wide draws. Chute starts provide a long straight runway before cornering, allowing jockeys time to find cover.
handicapping_angles.melbourne_metro_trainer_targets: Given its proximity to Melbourne and premier surface, elite Metro trainers (Hayes, Freedman, Maher, Moody/Coleman, Busuttin/Young) send high-quality progressive horses here. Respect these runners heavily when dropping from Metro midweek or Saturday grade (+3.0 pts).
handicapping_angles.seymour_cup_carnival: During the Seymour Cup ($200k) feature meeting in October, track class elevates to Metro/Group level.
